dimensions.name: Engagement with all three conversations
dimensions.criteria: All three run, with actual transcripts or faithful accounts. Follow-ups asked. Real subject matter, not placeholder queries.

dimensions.name: Observation of mechanics
dimensions.criteria: The reflection connects what was observed to how the system works — prediction, training data, context — rather than only reporting what it said.

dimensions.name: Calibration
dimensions.criteria: A prediction was made before Conversation 2, compared honestly afterward, and the direction of error is named. Accuracy isn't scored; honesty and specificity are.

dimensions.name: Practical insight
dimensions.criteria: The habit named is concrete, tied to actual work, and checkable. Not "I'll be more careful."
